$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-bank/SCENARIOS.md. The bank, its customers and their documents are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

replies.Oakhaven, USD 18,000: application pack:
Summary
Marguerite Oakhaven (CUS-1012) applies for a personal loan of USD 18,000 over 36 months. The indicative instalment on the application record is 576.59.
Policy MTB-POL-030 requires four documents. All four are on file and in order. None is missing.
Gross monthly income is 5,200 on the form, the payslips and the employment letter. Net pay of 4,010 agrees between the payslips and the statements. No figure differs.
Saved: not saved. This reply comes from the stand-in, not from the lending system.

Draft review. For the lending officer. Not issued.

| 2 | Payslips, last three months | MTB-POL-030, required documents | Three months, each with gross 5,200.00 and net 4,010.00 | DOC-8102, lines Month -1 to Month -3 | in order | Nothing further. |

| 5 | Gross monthly income | MTB-POL-030, figures on the form must agree with the documents | Form 5,200. Payslips 5,200. Employment letter 5,200 | Application form, gross monthly income; DOC-8102; DOC-8104 | in order | The three agree. |
| 6 | Net monthly pay | MTB-POL-030, figures on the form must agree with the documents | Payslips 4,010. Salary credited in the statements 4,010 | DOC-8102; DOC-8103 | in order | The form gives no net figure. The two documents agree. |
| 7 | Existing monthly debt payments | MTB-POL-030, figures on the form must agree with the documents | Form 450. The statements show a car loan instalment of 450 each month | Application form, existing monthly debt payments; DOC-8103 | in order | The two agree. |

replies.Pinecrest Tooling, USD 120,000: credit m:
Summary
Pinecrest Tooling Works Ltd (CUS-1018) asks for USD 120,000 over 60 months at an indicative 9.0 percent, to replace two CNC machines. Policy MTB-POL-031 names three ratios.
Latest year (DOC-8302): revenue 1,640,000, EBITDA 258,000, net income 127,500. Revenue grew 6.7 percent the year before and 8.3 percent in the latest year. EBITDA margin is 15.7 percent.
Current ratio 1.43 (limit at least 1.20). Debt to equity 0.26 (limit at most 2.50). Debt service cover 3.31 (limit at least 1.25). All three are within policy.
With the new loan's debt service of about 29,892 a year, debt service cover would be 2.39.
Existing exposure in the bank's records: loan LN-9002, equipment loan, 180,000 outstanding, which agrees with the debt of 180,000 in the statements, and equipment collateral of 240,000.
Saved: not saved. This reply comes from the stand-in, not from the lending system.

Draft review. For the lending officer. Not issued.

| # | Item | Required by | What the file shows | Source | Mark | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Current ratio | MTB-POL-031: at least 1.20 | 1.43 = 505,000 / 352,000 | DOC-8302, balance sheet, latest year: Total current assets 505,000; Total current liabilities 352,000 | in order | 0.23 above the limit. |
| 2 | Debt to equity | MTB-POL-031: at most 2.50 | 0.26 = (120,000 + 60,000) / 697,500 | DOC-8302, balance sheet, latest year: Long-term debt 120,000; Current portion of long-term debt 60,000; Total equity 697,500 | in order | Interest-bearing debt is the long-term debt plus the current portion, as the policy defines it. |
| 3 | Debt service cover | MTB-POL-031: at least 1.25 | 3.31 = 258,000 / (18,000 + 60,000) | DOC-8302, latest year: EBITDA 258,000; Interest expense 18,000; Current portion of long-term debt 60,000 | in order | The current portion is read as the principal due in the next year. |
| 4 | Debt service cover with the new loan | MTB-POL-031: at least 1.25. The policy tests the latest year. This row adds the new loan | 2.39 = 258,000 / (78,000 + about 29,892) | DOC-8302 as above; application record: USD 120,000, 60 months, 9.0 percent | in order | The new loan's debt service is a calculation: monthly 2,491.00, times 12. Check the rate and term. |

Proposal: refer to the credit officer with this memo; all three ratios are within policy.
